mapper.sql: FROM AUCTION a JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRD_SN = a.PRD_SN JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = p.CAT_SN JOIN USERS u ON u.USR_SN = p.USR_SN LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE aucStatus ON aucStatus.CMM_CD = a.AUC_STATUS_CD LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE tradeMethod ON tradeMethod.CMM_CD = p.PRD_TRD_METHOD_CD LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pi.PRD_SN, f.FL_PATH AS THUMBNAIL_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE pi JOIN FILES f ON f.FL_SN = pi.FL_SN AND f.FL_USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN ( SELECT PRD_SN, MIN(CASE WHEN PRD_IMG_RPRS_YN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END * 100000 + PRD_IMG_SORT_NO) AS SORT_KEY FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE GROUP BY PRD_SN ) picked ON picked.PRD_SN = pi.PRD_SN AND picked.SORT_KEY = CASE WHEN pi.PRD_IMG_RPRS_YN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END * 100000 + pi.PRD_IMG_SORT_NO ) thumb ON thumb.PRD_SN = p.PRD_SN LEFT JOIN ( SELECT AUC_SN, COUNT(*) AS BID_COUNT FROM BID GROUP BY AUC_SN ) bid ON bid.AUC_SN = a.AUC_SN LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRD_SN, COUNT(*) AS FAVORITE_COUNT FROM PRODUCT_FAVORITE WHERE PRD_FAV_USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY PRD_SN ) favorite ON favorite.PRD_SN = p.PRD_SN

WHERE p.PRD_USE_YN = 'Y' AND p.PRD_STATUS_CD = 'PRDC0002'
AND p.USR_SN = #{condition.sellerId}
AND ( p.PRD_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.keyword}, '%') OR c.CAT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.keyword}, '%') OR u.USR_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.keyword}, '%') )
AND c.CAT_NM IN
#{category}
AND a.AUC_CUR_AMT >= #{condition.minPrice}
AND a.AUC_CUR_AMT <= #{condition.maxPrice}
AND p.PRD_IBY_AMT IS NOT NULL AND p.PRD_IBY_AMT > 0
AND p.PRD_TRD_METHOD_CD IN
#{tradeMethodCode}
AND a.AUC_STATUS_CD IN ( 'AUCC0001', 'AUCC0002', 'AUCC0003', 'AUCC0004', 'AUCC0005', 'AUCC0006', 'AUCC9001' )
AND a.AUC_STATUS_CD != 'AUCC0005'
AND ( 1 = 0
OR a.AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0001'
OR a.AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0002'
OR a.AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0003'
OR ( a.AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0002' AND a.AUC_END_DT BETWEEN NOW() AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) )
)
AND a.AUC_STATUS_CD IN ('AUCC0001', 'AUCC0002', 'AUCC0003')
AND ( a.AUC_STATUS_CD != 'AUCC0002' OR a.AUC_END_DT > NOW() )
AND a.AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0002' AND a.AUC_END_DT BETWEEN NOW() AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
mapper.select:
SELECT a.AUC_SN AS auctionId, p.PRD_SN AS productId, p.PRD_NM AS title, c.CAT_NM AS categoryName, a.AUC_CUR_AMT AS currentPrice, p.PRD_START_AMT AS startPrice, p.PRD_IBY_AMT AS instantBuyPrice, a.AUC_STATUS_CD AS auctionStatusCode, aucStatus.CMM_NM AS auctionStatusName, p.PRD_TRD_METHOD_CD AS tradeMethodCode, tradeMethod.CMM_NM AS tradeMethodName, a.AUC_START_DT AS startDateTime, a.AUC_END_DT AS endDateTime, COALESCE(bid.BID_COUNT, 0) AS bidCount, COALESCE(favorite.FAVORITE_COUNT, 0) AS favoriteCount, p.PRD_VIEW_CNT AS viewCount, u.USR_NM AS sellerName, thumb.THUMBNAIL_PATH AS thumbnailPath
ORDER BY a.AUC_CUR_AMT ASC, a.AUC_END_DT ASC
ORDER BY COALESCE(bid.BID_COUNT, 0) DESC, a.AUC_END_DT ASC
ORDER BY COALESCE(favorite.FAVORITE_COUNT, 0) DESC, a.AUC_SN DESC
ORDER BY (COALESCE(favorite.FAVORITE_COUNT, 0) * 100) + COALESCE(p.PRD_VIEW_CNT, 0) DESC, COALESCE(favorite.FAVORITE_COUNT, 0) DESC, COALESCE(p.PRD_VIEW_CNT, 0) DESC, a.AUC_SN DESC
ORDER BY a.AUC_REG_DT DESC, a.AUC_SN DESC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0003' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN a.AUC_STATUS_CD != 'AUCC0003' THEN a.AUC_END_DT END ASC, CASE WHEN a.AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0003' THEN a.AUC_END_DT END DESC, a.AUC_SN DESC
LIMIT #{condition.size} OFFSET #{condition.offset}

SELECT PRD_SN AS productId, AUC_SN AS auctionId FROM AUCTION WHERE PRD_SN IN
#{productId}

SELECT a.AUC_SN AS auctionId, p.PRD_NM AS title FROM AUCTION a JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRD_SN = a.PRD_SN WHERE a.AUC_SN IN
#{auctionId}

SELECT a.AUC_SN AS auctionId, p.PRD_SN AS productId, p.PRD_NM AS title, p.PRD_CN AS content, c.CAT_NM AS categoryName, a.AUC_CUR_AMT AS currentPrice, p.PRD_START_AMT AS startPrice, p.PRD_IBY_AMT AS instantBuyPrice, a.AUC_BID_UNIT_AMT AS bidUnitPrice, a.AUC_STATUS_CD AS auctionStatusCode, aucStatus.CMM_NM AS auctionStatusName, p.PRD_TRD_METHOD_CD AS tradeMethodCode, tradeMethod.CMM_NM AS tradeMethodName, a.AUC_START_DT AS startDateTime, a.AUC_END_DT AS endDateTime, COALESCE(bid.BID_COUNT, 0) AS bidCount, COALESCE(favorite.FAVORITE_COUNT, 0) AS favoriteCount, p.PRD_VIEW_CNT AS viewCount, u.USR_SN AS sellerId, u.USR_NM AS sellerName, ( SELECT highestBid.BID_SN FROM BID highestBid WHERE highestBid.AUC_SN = a.AUC_SN AND highestBid.BID_STATUS_CD = 'BIDC0001' ORDER BY highestBid.BID_AMT DESC, highestBid.BID_SN DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS currentHighestBidId, ( SELECT highestBid.USR_SN FROM BID highestBid WHERE highestBid.AUC_SN = a.AUC_SN AND highestBid.BID_STATUS_CD = 'BIDC0001' ORDER BY highestBid.BID_AMT DESC, highestBid.BID_SN DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS currentHighestBidderId, CASE WHEN #{userId} IS NOT NULL AND #{userId} = ( SELECT highestBid.USR_SN FROM BID highestBid WHERE highestBid.AUC_SN = a.AUC_SN AND highestBid.BID_STATUS_CD = 'BIDC0001' ORDER BY highestBid.BID_AMT DESC, highestBid.BID_SN DESC LIMIT 1 ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS currentHighestBidder, CASE WHEN #{userId} IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT highestBid.BID_TRD_METHOD_CD FROM BID highestBid WHERE highestBid.AUC_SN = a.AUC_SN AND highestBid.BID_STATUS_CD = 'BIDC0001' AND highestBid.USR_SN = #{userId} ORDER BY highestBid.BID_AMT DESC, highestBid.BID_SN DESC LIMIT 1 ) ELSE NULL END AS myBidTradeMethodCode, CASE WHEN #{userId} IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT highestBid.BID_DLVR_ADDR_SN FROM BID highestBid WHERE highestBid.AUC_SN = a.AUC_SN AND highestBid.BID_STATUS_CD = 'BIDC0001' AND highestBid.USR_SN = #{userId} ORDER BY highestBid.BID_AMT DESC, highestBid.BID_SN DESC LIMIT 1 ) ELSE NULL END AS myBidDeliveryAddressId, CASE WHEN #{userId} IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BID userBid WHERE userBid.AUC_SN = a.AUC_SN AND userBid.USR_SN = #{userId} ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS hasBidHistory FROM AUCTION a JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRD_SN = a.PRD_SN JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = p.CAT_SN JOIN USERS u ON u.USR_SN = p.USR_SN LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE aucStatus ON aucStatus.CMM_CD = a.AUC_STATUS_CD LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE tradeMethod ON tradeMethod.CMM_CD = p.PRD_TRD_METHOD_CD LEFT JOIN ( SELECT AUC_SN, COUNT(*) AS BID_COUNT FROM BID GROUP BY AUC_SN ) bid ON bid.AUC_SN = a.AUC_SN LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRD_SN, COUNT(*) AS FAVORITE_COUNT FROM PRODUCT_FAVORITE WHERE PRD_FAV_USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY PRD_SN ) favorite ON favorite.PRD_SN = p.PRD_SN WHERE a.AUC_SN = #{auctionId}

SELECT a.AUC_SN AS aucSn, a.PRD_SN AS prdSn, a.AUC_STATUS_CD AS aucStatusCd, a.AUC_CUR_AMT AS aucCurAmt, COUNT(b.BID_SN) AS bidCount, a.AUC_START_DT AS aucStartDt, a.AUC_END_DT AS aucEndDt, a.AUC_EXT_CNT AS aucExtCnt FROM AUCTION a LEFT JOIN BID b ON b.AUC_SN = a.AUC_SN WHERE a.PRD_SN = #{prdSn} GROUP BY a.AUC_SN, a.PRD_SN, a.AUC_STATUS_CD, a.AUC_CUR_AMT, a.AUC_START_DT, a.AUC_END_DT, a.AUC_EXT_CNT

SELECT pi.PRD_IMG_SN AS imageId, f.FL_SN AS fileId, f.FL_ORG_NM AS originalName, f.FL_PATH AS path, pi.PRD_IMG_RPRS_YN AS representative, pi.PRD_IMG_SORT_NO AS sortNo FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE pi JOIN FILES f ON f.FL_SN = pi.FL_SN AND f.FL_USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE pi.PRD_SN = #{productId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN pi.PRD_IMG_RPRS_YN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, pi.PRD_IMG_SORT_NO, pi.PRD_IMG_SN

SELECT b.BID_SN AS bidId, b.BID_AMT AS bidPrice, b.BID_STATUS_CD AS bidStatusCode, bidStatus.CMM_NM AS bidStatusName, u.USR_NM AS bidderName, b.BID_REG_DT AS bidDateTime FROM BID b JOIN USERS u ON u.USR_SN = b.USR_SN LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE bidStatus ON bidStatus.CMM_CD = b.BID_STATUS_CD WHERE b.AUC_SN = #{auctionId} ORDER BY b.BID_AMT DESC, b.BID_REG_DT DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT a.AUC_SN AS auctionId, p.PRD_SN AS productId, p.PRD_USE_YN AS productUseYn, p.USR_SN AS sellerId, currentBid.BID_SN AS currentHighestBidId, currentBid.USR_SN AS currentHighestBidderId, currentBid.BID_TRD_METHOD_CD AS currentHighestTradeMethodCode, currentBid.BID_DLVR_ADDR_SN AS currentHighestDeliveryAddressId, a.AUC_CUR_AMT AS currentPrice, a.AUC_BID_UNIT_AMT AS bidUnitPrice, p.PRD_IBY_AMT AS instantBuyPrice, p.PRD_TRD_METHOD_CD AS tradeMethodCode, a.AUC_STATUS_CD AS auctionStatusCode, a.AUC_END_DT AS endDateTime, NOW() AS databaseNow FROM AUCTION a JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRD_SN = a.PRD_SN LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ranked.BID_SN, ranked.AUC_SN, ranked.USR_SN, ranked.BID_TRD_METHOD_CD, ranked.BID_DLVR_ADDR_SN FROM ( SELECT b.BID_SN, b.AUC_SN, b.USR_SN, b.BID_TRD_METHOD_CD, b.BID_DLVR_ADDR_SN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY b.AUC_SN ORDER BY b.BID_AMT DESC, b.BID_SN DESC ) AS RN FROM BID b WHERE b.BID_STATUS_CD = 'BIDC0001' ) ranked WHERE ranked.RN = 1 ) currentBid ON currentBid.AUC_SN = a.AUC_SN WHERE a.AUC_SN = #{auctionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT a.AUC_SN AS aucSn, p.USR_SN AS sellerUsrSn, a.AUC_STATUS_CD AS aucStatusCd FROM AUCTION a JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRD_SN = a.PRD_SN WHERE a.AUC_SN = #{auctionId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.AUC_SN AS auctionId, p.USR_SN AS sellerUserSn, currentBid.BID_SN AS highestBidId, currentBid.USR_SN AS highestBidderUserSn, a.AUC_STATUS_CD AS auctionStatusCode, a.AUC_START_DT AS startAt, a.AUC_END_DT AS endAt, NOW() AS databaseNow, trade.TRD_SN AS tradeSn, trade.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatusCode FROM AUCTION a JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRD_SN = a.PRD_SN LEFT JOIN BID currentBid ON currentBid.BID_SN = ( SELECT b.BID_SN FROM BID b WHERE b.AUC_SN = a.AUC_SN AND b.BID_STATUS_CD = 'BIDC0001' ORDER BY b.BID_AMT DESC, b.BID_SN DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN TRADE trade ON trade.TRD_SN = ( SELECT t.TRD_SN FROM TRADE t WHERE t.PRD_SN = p.PRD_SN AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' ORDER BY t.TRD_REG_DT DESC, t.TRD_SN DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE (p.USR_SN = #{userSn} OR currentBid.USR_SN = #{userSn}) AND a.AUC_STATUS_CD IN ( 'AUCC0001', 'AUCC0002', 'AUCC0003', 'AUCC0006', 'AUCC0013', 'AUCC9001' ) ORDER BY a.AUC_SN FOR UPDATE
SELECT AUC_SN FROM AUCTION WHERE AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0002' AND AUC_END_DT <= NOW() ORDER BY AUC_END_DT, AUC_SN LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT AUC_SN FROM AUCTION WHERE AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0001' AND AUC_START_DT <= NOW() ORDER BY AUC_START_DT, AUC_SN LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT AUC_SN FROM AUCTION WHERE AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0002' AND AUC_END_DT > NOW() AND AUC_END_DT <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) ORDER BY AUC_END_DT, AUC_SN LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT favorite.USR_SN FROM AUCTION auction JOIN PRODUCT product ON product.PRD_SN = auction.PRD_SN JOIN PRODUCT_FAVORITE favorite ON favorite.PRD_SN = product.PRD_SN AND favorite.PRD_FAV_USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE auction.AUC_SN = #{auctionId} AND auction.AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0002' AND auction.AUC_END_DT > NOW() AND auction.AUC_END_DT <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AND favorite.USR_SN != product.USR_SN UNION SELECT bid.USR_SN FROM AUCTION auction JOIN PRODUCT product ON product.PRD_SN = auction.PRD_SN JOIN BID bid ON bid.AUC_SN = auction.AUC_SN WHERE auction.AUC_SN = #{auctionId} AND auction.AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0002' AND auction.AUC_END_DT > NOW() AND auction.AUC_END_DT <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AND bid.USR_SN != product.USR_SN
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AUCTION ( PRD_SN, AUC_STATUS_CD, AUC_CUR_AMT, AUC_BID_UNIT_AMT, AUC_START_DT, AUC_END_DT, AUC_REG_ID, AUC_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{statusCode}, #{currentAmount}, #{bidUnitAmount}, #{startDateTime}, #{endDateTime}, #{actor}, #{actor} )
mapper.update: UPDATE AUCTION SET AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0002', AUC_UPDT_ID = #{actor}, AUC_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE AUC_SN = #{auctionId} AND AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0001' AND AUC_START_DT <= NOW()
UPDATE BID SET BID_STATUS_CD = 'BIDC0002', BID_DLVR_ADDR_SN = NULL, BID_UPDT_ID = 'SYSTEM', BID_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE AUC_SN = #{auctionId} AND BID_STATUS_CD = 'BIDC0001'
UPDATE BID SET BID_STATUS_CD = 'BIDC0004', BID_UPDT_ID = #{actor}, BID_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE AUC_SN = #{auctionId} AND BID_SN = #{bidId} AND BID_STATUS_CD = 'BIDC0001'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BID ( AUC_SN, USR_SN, BID_AMT, BID_STATUS_CD, BID_TRD_METHOD_CD, BID_DLVR_ADDR_SN, BID_REG_ID, BID_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{auctionId}, #{userId}, #{bidAmount}, #{statusCode}, #{selectedTradeMethodCode}, #{selectedDeliveryAddressId}, #{actor}, #{actor} )
mapper.update: UPDATE AUCTION SET AUC_CUR_AMT = #{bidAmount}, AUC_UPDT_ID = #{actor}, AUC_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE AUC_SN = #{auctionId} AND AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0002' AND AUC_CUR_AMT < #{bidAmount}

UPDATE AUCTION SET AUC_END_DT = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{extensionMinutes} MINUTE), AUC_EXT_CNT = AUC_EXT_CNT + 1, AUC_UPDT_ID = #{actor}, AUC_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE AUC_SN = #{auctionId} AND AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0002' AND AUC_EXT_CNT < #{maxExtensionCount} AND AUC_END_DT > NOW() AND AUC_END_DT <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{extensionMinutes} MINUTE)

UPDATE AUCTION SET AUC_CUR_AMT = #{bidAmount}, AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0003', AUC_END_DT = NOW(), AUC_UPDT_ID = #{actor}, AUC_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE AUC_SN = #{auctionId} AND AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0002' AND AUC_END_DT > NOW()
UPDATE AUCTION SET AUC_STATUS_CD = #{statusCode}, AUC_UPDT_ID = #{actor}, AUC_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE AUC_SN = #{auctionId} AND AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0002' AND AUC_END_DT <= NOW()

UPDATE AUCTION SET AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0013', AUC_UPDT_ID = #{actor}, AUC_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE AUC_SN = #{auctionId} AND AUC_STATUS_CD = #{expectedStatusCode} AND AUC_STATUS_CD IN ('AUCC0001', 'AUCC0002', 'AUCC0006')

/* 담당자 7 · F-OPS-003: 진행 중 경매만 수동 일시중지합니다. */ UPDATE AUCTION SET AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC9001', AUC_UPDT_ID = #{actor}, AUC_UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE AUC_SN = #{auctionId} AND AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0002' AND AUC_END_DT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

/* 멈춘 시간만큼 종료시각을 연장해 일시중지 직전의 남은 시간을 보존합니다. */ UPDATE AUCTION SET AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0002', AUC_END_DT = DATE_ADD( AUC_END_DT, INTERVAL GREATEST( COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, AUC_UPDT_DT, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 0), 1 ) SECOND ), AUC_UPDT_ID = #{actor}, AUC_UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE AUC_SN = #{auctionId} AND AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC9001'

UPDATE AUCTION SET AUC_STATUS_CD = #{statusCode}, AUC_START_DT = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'AUCC0001' THEN DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL COALESCE(#{remainingStartSeconds}, 0) SECOND) ELSE AUC_START_DT END, AUC_END_DT = CASE WHEN #{statusCode} IN ('AUCC0001', 'AUCC0002') THEN DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL GREATEST(COALESCE(#{remainingSeconds}, 0), 1) SECOND) ELSE AUC_END_DT END, AUC_UPDT_ID = #{actor}, AUC_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE AUC_SN = #{auctionId} AND AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0013'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AUCTION a JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRD_SN = a.PRD_SN WHERE p.USR_SN = #{userSn} AND a.AUC_STATUS_CD IN ('AUCC0001', 'AUCC0002', 'AUCC9001')
